headline: Steam hardware shipper breach leaks customer data, including names and addresses
summary: Valve's European shipping partner, CEVA Logistics, suffered a data breach. Customer data, including names, addresses, phone numbers, and emails, may be exposed. The breach affects customers who ordered Steam hardware in Europe.

headline: This great retro-inspired keyboard now comes preassembled
summary: The Classic-TKL Underscore Edition keyboard offers a retro, wired design. It lacks a number pad and wireless connectivity. Key feature: it's now available preassembled.

headline: The first rival Android app store just arrived in the US Play Store
summary: Aptoide, a third-party app store, is now available on Google's Play Store in the US. This follows Google's legal battles with Epic Games. Aptoide specializes in mobile games.

headline: Ford’s new AI assistant can check your fuel levels and tire pressure
summary: Ford is launching a new AI assistant for its vehicles. It can answer questions about Ford/Lincoln cars, like fuel levels or towing capacity. The assistant will roll out in the Ford and Lincoln mobile apps.

headline: God of War Fans Agree Ryan Hurst's New Kratos Pic Looks Much Better Than Prime Video's Previous, Widely-Ridiculed Photo
summary: God of War fans praise Ryan Hurst's new Kratos photo. The image is a significant improvement over prior, criticized depictions. Prime Video is developing the God of War series.

headline: 'We're Totally Supporting It' — Take-Two Boss Says Borderlands 4 Performance 'Has Not Affected Our Plans at All' as Fans Await Year 2 Roadmap
summary: Take-Two boss Strauss Zelnick reaffirms commitment to Borderlands 4. He states the game's commercial performance hasn't impacted support plans. Fans are anticipating the Year 2 roadmap for the looter-shooter.

headline: 'It's Complicated': Daredevil Star Charlie Cox Responds to Spider-Man: Brand New Day, And The Punisher's Claim He's Never Had a Friend Like Peter Parker
summary: Daredevil actor Charlie Cox discusses a scene from "Spider-Man: Brand New Day." The scene involves Frank Castle (The Punisher) and Peter Parker. Cox commented on Punisher's claim about Parker's unique friendship.

headline: Burnout Revenge Is Actually the Best One
summary: The article declares Burnout Revenge to be the best title in the series. It presents a definitive opinion on the classic racing game. The piece likely explores the game's superior qualities.

headline: Record 230 people cross Channel in one small boat
summary: A record 230 people crossed the Channel in a single small boat. The Home Office highlights the "reckless and dangerous tactics" of gangs. These gangs are cramming increasing numbers onto unseaworthy vessels.

headline: 'Dust devil' spins through London park
summary: A small whirlwind, or "dust devil," was spotted in London's Greenwich Park. Footage captured the natural phenomenon on Sunday. It swirled around people in the park.

headline: Travelodge staff gave domestic abuser key to his victim's room
summary: Travelodge staff reportedly gave a domestic abuser a key to his victim's room. The victim stated her attacker then kicked her door off its hinges. The incident was recounted to the BBC.

headline: Evidence that South African special forces murdered top detective shared with BBC
summary: Evidence suggests South African special forces murdered top detective Frans Mathipa. Mathipa was shot while driving. The BBC gained access to the prosecution case against eight accused men.
